title: HSK1 Gate 18 · Yuan Dynasty
explanationEn: Gate 18: Yuan Dynasty. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第18关：元朝。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 七百多年以前，中国有一个很大的朝代，叫元朝。元朝的皇帝叫忽必烈，他的国家从东边一直到很远的西边。那时候路上比以前安全，来往的人多了。有一个年轻人从意大利出发，他叫马可·波罗。
passageEn: More than seven hundred years ago, China had a great dynasty called the Yuan. The Yuan emperor was Kublai Khan, and his realm reached from the east far into the west. In those days the roads were safer than before, so more people travelled. A young man set out from Italy; his name was Marco Polo.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: More than seven hundred years ago, China had a great dynasty called the Yuan.
comprehension.answer: 七百多年以前，中国有一个很大的朝代，叫元朝。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: In those days the roads were safer than before, so more people travelled.
comprehension.answer: 那时候路上比以前安全，来往的人多了。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

options.text: More than seven hundred years ago, China had a great dynasty called the Yuan.
Long ago, a great flood came to China.
The flood went into the fields, and into many people's homes.
People had nowhere to live, and could only go up the mountains to live.
